title: hibiscus ficulneus var. alboruber
intro: Hibiscus ficulneus var. alboruber, commonly known as white hibiscus, is a plant species within the mallow family (Malvaceae) that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of hibiscus ficulneus var. alboruber are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hypertensive properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents present in hibiscus ficulneus var. alboruber include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
